decisions.reason: Fruit-bottom yogurt draws directly on the firm's core cultured-dairy know-how, and its award gives a clear quality signal, so it stays despite not appearing on the website in 2020 and 2021.
The flagship flavoured cheese builds on established cheese competence, which lets management read its sales and refine the recipe, so keeping it remains justified.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a close extension of existing production knowledge and the organic milk supply, so it carries low risk even with little visibility online.
The spicy cheese line uses existing cheese know-how, so it is kept as a line, but its absence from the website suggests some variants may be trimmed.

The mild soft cheese belongs to the same soft-cheese family as the withdrawn washed-rind product F, where the firm's knowledge base proved weaker, and with no further signals since 2018 the resources are better used in the core business.
